Game Overview

Medieval Ships Defense is a strategy title where defend your village on a strategic medieval battlefield by placing towers to thwart waves of invading ships. Navigate eight thrilling levels plus a shark-infested bonus stage. Enhance your defenses, adapt to diverse enemies, and ensure your swimmers' safety in this addictive, tactical tower defense adventure.
